units.source_text: 二女公子近几日来心中愁绪万斛，然而不欲泄露，努力隐忍，装作若无其事的模样。

en.t: For the past few days, the Second Princess had been filled with boundless sorrow, but she did not want to reveal it. She tried hard to endure and acted as though nothing were wrong.

units.source_text: 因此听见头中将来到，只当作不知，神色泰然自若，心中实甚痛苦。

en.t: So when she heard that the Captain had arrived, she pretended not to know, keeping her expression calm and composed, though in her heart she was in great pain.

units.source_text: 匂亲王听见头中将来到，心念六女公子毕竟也很可怜，便准备前往，对二女公子说道：“我去一下立刻回来。

en.t: When Prince Niou heard that the Captain had arrived, he thought that the Sixth Princess was, after all, also to be pitied, and he prepared to go to her. He said to the Second Princess, "I will go for a moment and come back at once.

units.source_text: 你一个人‘莫对月明’。我心绪缭乱，实甚痛苦。”

en.t: Do not face the bright moon alone. My heart is in turmoil, and I am truly suffering."

units.source_text: 他觉得两人相对非常难过，就从荫蔽处走往正殿去。

en.t: He felt it was terribly painful for the two of them to remain facing one another, so he went from the sheltered place toward the main hall.

units.source_text: 二女公子目送他的背影，努力抑制悲伤之情，然而眼泪纷纷落下，大有‘孤枕漂浮’之感。

en.t: The Second Princess watched his figure recede and tried hard to hold back her grief, but tears fell one after another, and she felt as though her lonely pillow were drifting away.

units.source_text: 她自己也很诧异：“原来我也有嫉妒之情，人的心真是不足道啊！”

en.t: She herself was startled. "So I too have feelings of jealousy. How contemptible the human heart is!"

units.source_text: 又想：“我姐妹两人自幼身世孤苦，单靠一个遗世独立的父亲抚养成人，在山乡度送了悠长的岁月。

en.t: Then she thought, "My sister and I had lonely, hard lives from childhood. We were raised only by a father who lived apart from the world, and we spent long years in a mountain village.

units.source_text: 当时只觉得一年四季总是凄凉寂寞，却并不知道世间有如此伤心彻骨的忧患。

en.t: At that time I only felt that every season of the year was bleak and lonely, but I did not know that the world held grief so deep it pierced the bones.

units.source_text: 后来连续遭逢了父亲和姐姐的丧事，悲恸无限，片刻也不想生存在世。

en.t: Later I suffered the deaths of my father and my sister one after the other, and my grief was endless. I did not wish to live in this world for even a moment.

units.source_text: 只因命不该绝，苟且偷生直到今天。

en.t: Only because my life was not yet meant to end have I lingered on until today.

units.source_text: 最近迁来京都，出乎别人意料之外，也参与了富贵尊荣之列，原也不希望长久。

en.t: Recently I moved to the capital, beyond anyone's expectations, and joined the ranks of wealth and honor, though from the beginning I never hoped it would last.

units.source_text: 但念只要夫妻团圆，总可受到怜爱，因此悲伤之情渐渐消减，平安无事直到今天。

en.t: But I thought that as long as husband and wife could be together, I might always receive some affection, and so my sadness gradually lessened, and I lived peacefully until today.

units.source_text: 不料此次又发生了这意外之事，使我悲痛无极，眼见得我和他的因缘从此断绝了！

en.t: Unexpectedly, this unforeseen thing has happened again, causing me boundless sorrow. It is clear before my eyes that the bond between him and me has been severed from this moment on!

units.source_text: 我原可作如是想：他毕竟不是像父亲和姐姐那样与我永诀，今后虽然对我冷淡，也总得时时相见。

en.t: I could have thought this way: after all, he is not parting from me forever as my father and sister did. Even if he is cold to me from now on, we must still meet from time to time.

units.source_text: 但今夜如此狠心地舍弃了我，使我觉得前尘后事一旦成空，悲恸难忍，不能自已。

en.t: But tonight he abandoned me so heartlessly that I feel my past and future have suddenly come to nothing. My grief is unbearable, and I cannot control myself.

units.source_text: 我好痛苦啊！不过只要生存在世，或许自会……”

en.t: How I suffer! Yet as long as I remain alive, perhaps in time it may somehow..."

units.source_text: 她终于转过念头，聊以自慰。

en.t: At last she turned her thoughts aside and consoled herself a little.

units.source_text: 然而还是一任“舍姨山”的月亮皎皎升空，怀着万斛愁绪左思右想，直到天明。

en.t: Even so, she let the bright moon over Mount Obasute rise into the sky, and with a heart full of sorrow she turned her thoughts over and over until dawn.

units.source_text: 平时听见松风徐徐吹拂，比较起荒僻的宇治山庄来，在这里原是悠闲、平静而可爱的。

en.t: Ordinarily, hearing the pine wind blow softly here would have seemed leisurely, peaceful, and lovely compared with the desolate mountain villa at Uji.

units.source_text: 但二女公子今夜并无此感，只觉得比柯叶的声音更加难听。

en.t: But the Second Princess felt none of that tonight. To her, it sounded even more unpleasant than the rustling of withered leaves.

units.source_text: 吟诗云：

en.t: She composed a poem:
